title: Cache vendor linux-rpi builds
description:
Vendor-kernel builds have no public Hydra jobset, so a `nix flake update` that bumps nixos-hardware can trigger a multi-hour build before a deploy. `task cache-push` pushes only an already-built host closure. Add a path that builds and pushes new kernel closures promptly (scheduled CI job or a documented pre-update cache step) to Cachix/Attic.

Source: README 'Known risks' (vendor kernel builds are uncached).
acceptance_criteria: A flake-input bump has a documented, low-effort way to populate the new kernel closure in Cachix/Attic; the README risk is updated or removed.

title: Check that every host key is a sops recipient
description:
A host whose SSH host key is missing from `.sops.yaml` silently fails secret decryption at boot, so incus gets no ACME credentials and no certificate is issued. Add a check (flake check or `scripts/verify-host.sh`) that every host in `inventory.nix`/`hosts/` has a matching age recipient in `.sops.yaml` and that the encrypted files decrypt with it.

Source: README 'Known risks' (sops).
acceptance_criteria: A missing recipient fails a local or CI check with a clear error before deploy; adding a host documents the rekey step.

title: Backlog migrated from README scan
description: Repository-wide scan (README.md, AGENTS.md, Taskfile.yml, modules/, scripts/, .github/) found no TODO/FIXME comments and no open GitHub issues; the actionable work lives in README's 'Known risks' and 'Future paths'. This epic groups that backlog. Non-actionable risks (PSU/cooling, ACME availability and rate limits, disko legacy-table warning, impermanence review process) stay as documentation and are not tracked as tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Every actionable README item has a focused child issue with its source and acceptance criteria; README no longer duplicates tracker state.

title: Document and check root CA rotation
description:
Internal TLS trust is pinned to the vendored Esselius root CA. Rotating step-ca without updating `certs/esselius-root-ca.crt` breaks Attic substitution and logs TLS warnings on every Nix invocation. Add a rotation runbook and a check that the vendored root still validates the Attic endpoint.

Source: README 'Known risks' (internal TLS trust).
acceptance_criteria: A documented rotation procedure exists and scripts/verify-host.sh or CI detects a stale or mismatched root.

title: Decide and narrow Incus API/UI exposure
description:
Incus listens on `core.https_address = ":8443"` and the firewall opens the port globally, so the API/UI is reachable from the LAN and the VPN, not just `wg0`. Client auth is certificate-based. Decide whether the broader exposure is wanted; if not, narrow the listener and nftables rule to the LAN/VPN addresses or `wg0`.

Source: README 'Known risks' (Incus API/UI listens on all interfaces).
acceptance_criteria: The intended exposure is documented; if narrowed, port 8443 is no longer reachable from untrusted networks and scripts/verify-host.sh still passes.

title: CI: add NixOS VM tests
description:
The CI comment reserves `checks.aarch64-linux` for 'future NixOS VM tests'. No VM tests exist today. Add at least one VM test that boots a host config and asserts core units (incus, unbound, wg) or at least evaluates/boots the bootstrap image, wired through `mkChecks` so the macOS and aarch64-linux check sets stay in sync.

Source: .github/workflows/ci.yml and flake.nix `mkChecks`.
acceptance_criteria: A NixOS VM test runs under  on aarch64-linux; the macOS check set evaluates the same attributes; CI stays green.

title: README: drop stale 'not yet scripted' install bullet
description:
README 'Verification status' still says the mount + `nixos-enter` dance was 'exercised by hand several times, not yet scripted', while a later bullet states `nixos-anywhere --disko-mode mount` now automates it and the manual chroot is no longer required. Remove or rewrite the stale bullet so the status list matches the current soft-reset path.

Source: README 'Verification status'.
acceptance_criteria: README no longer claims the manual SD population is unscripted; the soft-reset bullet is the single description of how the SD boot partition is populated.

title: Document Zigbee passthrough and multi-host scaling
description:
README lists Zigbee passthrough details and secondary hosts at scale as additive future work; both Pis already have WireGuard, DNS, and cross-host routing. Write the concrete steps (USB device passthrough, per-host addressing, inventory/site changes) and validate one Zigbee device on an instance.

Source: README 'Future paths'.
acceptance_criteria: A playbook documents Zigbee passthrough and adding a third host; the steps are verified against the current modules.

title: Re-evaluate mainline kernel for Pi 5
description:
Vendor `linux-rpi` is used because mainline produced `rp1_driver -22` against the firmware DTBs. Re-test mainline once nixos-hardware/nixpkgs settle the Pi 5 DTB story (tracked via NixOS/nixos-hardware#78): USB/Ethernet, NVMe, and an incus VM guest on 16K pages.

Source: README kernel decision and 'Future paths'.
acceptance_criteria: A documented test result either keeps the vendor kernel with an updated rationale or moves the hosts to mainline with verification evidence.

title: Add IPv6 to the incusbr-vpn bridge
description:
`incusbr-vpn` is deliberately IPv4-only (`ipv6.address = "none"` and the masquerade table is family `ip`); IPv6 is out of scope until added deliberately. Add IPv6 addressing/NAT on both hosts, or record the permanent out-of-scope decision.

Source: README 'VPN-reachable instances'.
acceptance_criteria: Either IPv6 is configured and verified across both hosts, or the README states the permanent decision and this issue is closed.

title: NVMe-only boot once U-Boot 2026.10 lands in nixpkgs
description:
Boot files currently live on microSD because nixpkgs' U-Boot cannot read them from NVMe. Upstream NVMe boot landed for U-Boot 2026.10. Once nixpkgs ships it, add an NVMe FAT partition to disko, set EEPROM `BOOT_ORDER` to include NVMe, and retire the SD from daily duty. Fold in the M.2 hat EEPROM quirks (nvmd/nixos-raspberrypi #117).

Source: README 'Future paths' and the boot-device decision.
acceptance_criteria: Host boots entirely from NVMe with the SD removed; install/rebuild/rollback playbooks are updated; SD remains only as optional recovery.
